records.name: l10n_tr_nilvera_einvoice_extended.tax.office.list
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <list string="Tax Offices" multi_edit="1">
                <field name="code" optional="hide"/>
                <field name="name"/>
                <field name="state_code"/>
                <field name="state_id"/>
            </list>
        </field>

records.name: l10n_tr_nilvera_einvoice_extended.tax.office.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <form string="Tax Office">
                <sheet>
                    <group>
                        <group>
                            <field name="name"/>
                            <field name="code"/>
                        </group>
                        <group>
                            <field name="state_id"/>
                            <field name="state_code"/>
                        </group>
                    </group>
                </sheet>
            </form>
        </field>
